_comment: Public site config. Only PUBLIC values ever live here (CLAUDE.md's locked decision, amended 2026-09-19): the Supabase URL and anon key are public by design and RLS, not secrecy, protects the data. Never a service-role key, a DB password, the OneSignal REST key, an Anthropic key or CFBP_JOB_SECRET.
_retiredComment: RETIRED 2026-09-23 (UN-237/238): "backendUrl" and "backendToken" are GONE. They were the Google Apps Script /exec URL and its shared token, and they shipped here from the Option A bootstrap until the Sheet was retired. Nothing in the app reads either key any more — js/backend.js's call() and js/chatTransport.js's get()/post() were deleted in the same commit — so leaving them would have been a live credential for a live deployment with no caller: exactly the thing rotation exists to prevent, left in the repo for nobody's benefit. Drew archives the Sheet read-only and clears the Apps Script Script Properties as part of the same ceremony (docs/SUPABASE_LIVE_RUNBOOK.md, RETIREMENT). ROLLBACK, if it is ever needed: restoring these two keys alone does NOT restore the transport — the code that used them is gone, and the rollback is a git revert of that commit plus a redeploy.
_oneSignalComment: PUBLIC OneSignal App ID (Groups A/B push, 2026-09-10) — safe to ship in source, per DESIGN_INPUTS_BATCH1_091026.md Appendix. The REST API key is NEVER put here. It lived in Apps Script Script Properties until 2026-09-23 and now lives ONLY as a Supabase function secret (notify-fanout). Empty string = push stays off; js/push-onesignal.js no-ops cleanly.
_authComment: CUTOVER 2026-09-19 (Phase III Step 8, v0.22.1 after RG-163/RG-164): authMode and dataMode are BOTH 'supabase' from this commit; they move together or not at all (DI §8.1). Rollback = remove both keys in one commit and deploy. Since 2026-09-23 removing them means LOCAL-ONLY, not Google Sheets: the Sheets transport is deleted, so a device without these keys has a working single-device app and no shared backend (js/backend.js's header states this in full). The paragraph that follows is the pre-cutover history and its hazard statement, kept verbatim. — Phase III Step 3a (DI-180f). authMode is DELIBERATELY ABSENT here, and absent/'pins' is the safe default (CONVENTIONS #10). THE HAZARD IS NOT ONBOARDING FRICTION. Setting "authMode": "supabase" on this build would derive isAdmin from a league_members row in a Supabase project ANY Google account can sign into and create a league in, and hand that derived commissioner flag to an app whose every write still lands in the live six-player league's Google Sheet (js/supabase-backend.js, Step 4, does not exist yet). A stranger would be commissioner of the real league. js/auth.js's hasSupabaseDataBackend() interlock now refuses that combination outright — banner, no session, and storage.save() throws — so this is defence in depth, not the only guard. Do not set authMode here until Step 4 has shipped AND Drew has approved cutover. supabaseUrl/supabaseAnonKey below are safe to ship regardless of authMode: the anon key is public-by-design (AD-05/AD-40 precedent for backendToken: inert without a user JWT, bounded by RLS) and is read but unused while authMode stays 'pins'.
